attribute_fields.COMMENTS: DC military retirement exemption (2025). Very limited: only $3,000 if age 62+, otherwise fully taxable. DC is one of only 2 jurisdictions that substantially tax military retirement. Honors MSRRA and SCRA. Source: MOAA State Report Card.

initial_action.action_postfix: "DC Military Retirement Exemption Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.dc_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.dc_military_retirement_taxable xdef

action_details.action_postfix:
result.military_retirement_pay result.dc_military_retirement_exemption_amount min /result.dc_military_retirement_exemption xdef
result.military_retirement_pay result.dc_military_retirement_exemption sub 0 max /result.dc_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"DC military retirement exemption (age 62+): $" result.dc_military_retirement_exemption cvs strconcat " (Age: " strconcat result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Taxable: $" strconcat result.dc_military_retirement_taxable cvs strconcat ")" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto

0.0 /result.dc_military_retirement_exemption xdef result.military_retirement_pay /result.dc_military_retirement_taxable xdef
"DC military retirement: NO EXEMPTION (age < 62). Age: " result.age cvs strconcat ", Retirement: $" strconcat result.military_retirement_pay cvs strconcat ", Fully taxable" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
0.0 /result.dc_military_retirement_exemption xdef 0.0 /result.dc_military_retirement_taxable xdef "No DC military retirement pay - exemption not applicable" job.audit_trail swap addto

attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Washington DC income tax calculation. Implements progressive tax structure with 7 brackets per DC Office of Tax and Revenue (2025).

initial_action.action_postfix: "Washington DC Tax Calculation Started" job.audit_trail swap addto 0.0 /result.dc_state_tax xdef

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly
Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_comment: Calculate DC tax for Single filers using progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix:
result.agi result.dc_standard_deduction_single sub 0 max dup /dc_taxable_income xdef
0.0 /dc_tax xdef
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_1_limit min result.dc_bracket_1_rate mul /dc_tax xdef
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_1_limit gt { dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_2_limit min result.dc_bracket_1_limit sub result.dc_bracket_2_rate mul dc_tax add /dc_tax xdef } if
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_2_limit gt { dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_3_limit min result.dc_bracket_2_limit sub result.dc_bracket_3_rate mul dc_tax add /dc_tax xdef } if
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_3_limit gt { dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_4_limit min result.dc_bracket_3_limit sub result.dc_bracket_4_rate mul dc_tax add /dc_tax xdef } if
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_4_limit gt { dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_5_limit min result.dc_bracket_4_limit sub result.dc_bracket_5_rate mul dc_tax add /dc_tax xdef } if
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_5_limit gt { dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_6_limit min result.dc_bracket_5_limit sub result.dc_bracket_6_rate mul dc_tax add /dc_tax xdef } if
dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_6_limit gt { dc_taxable_income result.dc_bracket_6_limit sub result.dc_bracket_7_rate mul dc_tax add /dc_tax xdef } if
dc_tax /result.dc_state_tax xdef dc_tax /result.state_tax_liability xdef
"Washington DC tax calculated (Single): $" result.dc_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
